title: Dental fillings and crowns in Mohandessin
description: Compare composite fillings and dental crowns in Mohandessin for decay or fractured teeth. Learn how remaining tooth, bite and sensitivity guide the plan.
h1: Dental fillings and crowns in Mohandessin
answer: Composite fillings repair selected defects, while crowns cover a tooth that needs more support. {{brand}} in Mohandessin assesses people with decay, a broken tooth or a failing restoration. The amount of sound tooth remaining, bite forces and gum health guide the choice and the number of visits.
preparation: Tell us about biting pain, clenching and recent fractures. Deep decay or nerve symptoms may need other treatment first.
howPerformed: We examine the tooth and remove decay where indicated. A filling is shaped directly, or a tooth is prepared and measured for a crown.
followup: Wait for numbness to settle before chewing. A high bite, persistent sensitivity or a loose temporary crown needs review.
risks: Possible problems include sensitivity, fractures and later decay at a restoration edge. A damaged nerve may need root canal treatment.
